name: FAQ accordion
definition: List of common questions where each answer expands in place, so objections are handled without leaving the page.
bestUse: Just above the final call to action, or on pricing pages.

demo.how: Questions are buttons that expand their answer below, so visitors scan the questions and open only what worries them. Click a question or press Enter or Space; the plus turns to a minus and the button reports expanded. Opening one closes the others to keep the list short. Answers are illustrative.
